title: Tributary Interconnection for Digital Control Interface
scope: This practice describes the mechanism for the transfer of control messages between tributaries used within a general-purpose communications channel of an interface system which transports data and digital control signals between equipment utilized in the production, post-production, and/or transmission of visual and aural information. It is intended that the mechanism described in this practice be utilized when transferring control messages between tributaries used as a part of an overall system.
